title: Mechanical testing of metals - Tensile Testing
clause_1_scope: This International Standard specifies the method for tensile testing of metallic materials and defines the mechanical properties which can be determined at ambient temperature.

clause_2_normative_references.title: the National Flag of India (Cotton Khadi) (BI-LINGUAL)
Colors for Ready Mixed Paints and Enamels

mechanical_properties: elongation of a gauge length (L ) of 80 mm
Elongation after fracture (L u - L ) shall be determined to the nearest 0,25 mm
marking_requirements: Each product/package must bear the manufacturer's name, trademark, and grade.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS ISI Mark) subject to licensing.
